description: Ministry of Sports - Sri Lanka Anti-Doping Agency -  Published the Anti-Doping (prohibited list) Regulations, No. 03 of 2017 effective from 01.01.2018
reasoning: This gazette content primarily involves the publication of regulations under the Convention Against Doping in Sports Act, specifically the Anti-Doping (Prohibited List) Regulations. It contains detailed regulatory provisions about prohibited substances and methods in sports, which falls under legal/regulatory matters. While it mentions the Minister of Sports (Dayasiri Jayasekera), this is only in the context of who made the regulations, not detailing his portfolio responsibilities or making personnel changes. The core content is regulatory in nature, making it Type 5 (Legal/Regulatory).
